## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 按地区和时区过滤
WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
  AND tz_type = 'regional'

-- 日期范围过滤
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-31'

-- 近 90 天滚动窗口
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 89 DAYS) AND DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- JOIN 商家信息表，获取商家属性
LEFT JOIN shop_listing b ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id

-- JOIN 商品级 GMV 表，获取 item_amount

  ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id
 AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date
 AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region

-- JOIN 广告扣费表，计算 Take Rate
LEFT JOIN ads_rev ON a.shop_id = ads_rev.shop_id
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. Take Rate 分析 (商家广告净收入 / 商家总 GMV)

```sql
-- Source: mkplpaidads_search_ads/manual_tasks/zhiyong.wu/take_rate/take_rate_get
seller_gmv AS (
    SELECT
        shop_id,
        SUM(gmv_1d) AS total_gmv_local,
        SUM(gmv_usd_1d) AS total_gmv_usd
    FROM mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
      AND tz_type = 'regional'
      AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-02' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
    GROUP BY shop_id
)
```

### 2. 平台全站 GMV 按日监控

```sql
-- Source: mkplpaidads_brand_ads/manual_tasks/sihao/platform_gmv
SELECT
    grass_region,
    grass_date,
    SUM(gmv_usd_1d) AS platformwide_gmv_usd
FROM mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date >= DATE('2022-11-16')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### 3. Key Seller 打标 (dim_shop_info 工作流)

```sql
-- Source: data_paidadsmart/workflows/.../dim_shop_info_daily__sg_s0_live
SELECT
    a.shop_id AS shop_id,
    CASE WHEN PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY shop_level1_global_be_category
        ORDER BY platform_gmv_usd ASC
    ) >= 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS key_seller_90,
    CASE WHEN PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY shop_level1_global_be_category
        ORDER BY platform_gmv_usd ASC
    ) >= 0.95 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS key_seller_95,
    platform_gmv_usd AS seller_platform_gmv_for_tier_usd
FROM (
    SELECT shop_id, SUM(gmv_usd_1d) AS platform_gmv_usd
    FROM mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
      AND grass_date = '${grass_date}'
      AND tz_type = 'local'
    GROUP BY shop_id
) a
LEFT JOIN shop_listing b ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id
```
